_readme: THE WORKBOOK TEMPLATE OF RECORD, pinned. Drive sheet 18IoJD5jn9aIe3E_F2omxqIZrjnHQwfR2pD0-_nUe5zc
('DMA Workbook', contract v3, template 2.0.0, modified 2026-08-31), measured 2026-09-03.
It is the RESEARCH-stage shape: 11 core columns A-K on every scoring sheet, the synthesis
working area from column L, a DQ_Bank of 6810 rows (851 subcaps x 8 facets) that carries
SubCap_Name for every cell (engine/data/catalogue_v70_names.json is extracted from it),
The ENGINE CONTRACT (engine/contract.py) is authoritative for what a run WRITES — it is
this template plus the tabs the app reads and the assessment stage fills (the 43-sheet
Golden 1 shape in gold_reference.json). `engine.template check` diffs a workbook against
the contract; `engine.template drift` diffs THIS pin against the contract and names each
difference so a divergence is a reviewed decision rather than an accident.
title: DMA Workbook

DQ_Bank: Signals, value dimensions or divergence types

known_divergences_from_contract.Evidence_Detail: template columns (Evidence_ID, Claim, Direction, DQ_Facet, ERS_Core, ERS_Total, URL) vs contract (E_ID, Source_URL, ERS, Date_Published, Claim_Type, Fact_Count, Origin...). The contract's are the app parser's own names (parse_evidence_master aliases) and stay.
known_divergences_from_contract.Entity_Timeline: template (Date, Role, SubCap_IDs, Fact_ID, Summary) vs contract (Event_Date, Title, Body, Kind, Signal, Maturity_Effect, Claim_Label, SubCap_IDs, Evidence_IDs) — the contract's is the C1 timeline surface's own vocabulary.
known_divergences_from_contract.Coverage: template (Category, Pillar, Subcaps_In_Scope, With_Evidence, Coverage, Evidence_Items, Floor_Pass, Gate) vs contract (Category_ID, Selected, Researched, Items, Floor_Pass, Floor_Pass_Pct, Synthesised, Verdict); the assessment stage adds Coverage_Map with the gold disclosure columns (Scored / Unknown_EvidenceGap / Coverage_Pct).
known_divergences_from_contract.working_area: template carries Cov_works.. facet coverage flags; contract carries the DQ_* answer columns and the challenge/absence columns. Both keep A-K byte-identical, which is what the validator and the app read.
